items.title: Add Tenant
questionVariations: How do I add a tenant?
How can I create a new tenant?
I want to add a new tenant
items.answer: To add a tenant, open Dashboard or Members, click Add Member, fill name, mobile, room details and rent info, then save. The tenant will appear in active members immediately.

items.title: Mark Rent Paid
questionVariations: How do I mark rent paid?
Tenant paid rent what should I do
items.answer: To mark rent paid, open Payments or tenant profile, select the tenant, click Pay/Add Payment, enter amount, date, and method, then save. Dues update instantly.

items.title: View Reports
items.answer: For reports, open Monthly Earnings or Analytics from sidebar. You can review collections, pending dues, monthly trends, and apply filters by date.

items.title: Add New Property
questionVariations: How do I add a new property?
items.answer: To add another property or branch, contact admin via in-app admin chat or WhatsApp and share new property details. Admin can enable separate setup.

items.title: Manage Rooms
items.answer: Open Rooms from sidebar, add floor/room details, configure beds, and save. Update occupancy whenever tenants are allocated or vacated.

items.title: View Tenant List
questionVariations: Where can I see all tenants?
items.answer: Open Members to see active tenants. Use Inactive Members tab for exited tenants. Search and filters help you quickly find specific profiles.

items.title: Check Payment History
items.answer: Open member profile from Members, then go to payment history section. You can view all transactions, pending amounts, and receipt details.

items.title: Use Dashboard
questionVariations: What can I see on dashboard
items.answer: Dashboard gives a quick snapshot of members, dues, and collections. Use action cards to jump to add member, collect rent, and review trends.

items.title: Manage Supervisors
questionVariations: Can I give staff limited access
items.answer: Open Supervisors page, add supervisor details, then select permissions for members, payments, and rooms. You can edit or disable access later.

items.title: View Audit Log
questionVariations: How to see who changed data
items.answer: Open Audit Log from sidebar to review key actions done in your account, including member updates, payment changes, and security-related events.

items.title: Contact Admin
items.answer: You can contact admin from profile menu or use the WhatsApp option in assistant. Share your exact issue and tenant/account details for faster help.
